narration.text: Start with the source: Searchbloom discloses that it publishes this agency list and ranks itself first, making that position its own ranking rather than an independent verdict.
Searchbloom says the facts come from company websites, while case-study figures are the companies’ own reporting.

scenes.visual_direction: Place the self-ranking disclosure and case-study sourcing in two stacked cards, bringing each forward as its narration is heard.

narration.text: For success, Searchbloom recommends leads, sign-ups, or revenue from AI referrals, rather than citation counts or visibility scores.
For evidence, it recommends requesting a dated AI search result with a named or described company, a figure, and a period.
Searchbloom also flags promises of AI citations in weeks, and reports that count citations without mentioning leads or revenue.

on_screen.text: Searchbloom recommends leads, sign-ups, or revenue

scenes.visual_direction: Center the outcome takeaway beside an abstract evidence card; reveal empty date, company, figure, and period compartments without adding example results.

narration.text: AI answers are probabilistic: repeating the same question can produce different brands.
Searchbloom recommends tracking fixed, real buyer questions daily across the platforms buyers use, then reading the trend.
It recommends separating branded and non-branded prompts, segmented by awareness, consideration, and purchase.
Searchbloom recommends asking which tracking tool, prompts, platforms, and run frequency an agency uses.

on_screen.text: Searchbloom recommends daily tracking of buyer questions

scenes.visual_direction: Animate one question card returning different abstract answer arrangements, then organize repeated question cards into a calendar grid without numerical results or trend lines.

narration.text: In Searchbloom’s own tracking, about nine of every ten sources AI cites are on other people’s sites.
Searchbloom recommends requesting the outside URLs retrieved and cited for top buyer questions, including placements the agency can help secure.
When an answer omits a business, Searchbloom recommends inspecting its cited pages; often, the fix is a listing through outreach, a review, or sponsorship.

on_screen.text: Searchbloom recommends requesting outside cited URLs

scenes.visual_direction: Arrange an abstract answer panel beside outside-page cards; draw connectors from the answer to those cards, then highlight one card as the inspection step is discussed.

narration.text: Crawler access, correct structured data, and clean architecture make a site legible to AI platforms.
Searchbloom assigns technical, content, and entity work to the agency, alongside tracking reviewed monthly with the client.
It recommends clarifying whether the agency builds changes or supplies recommendations, and pricing the developer time the client must provide.

on_screen.text: Searchbloom recommends clarifying builds versus recommendations

scenes.visual_direction: Use a site schematic above two delivery lanes representing implementation and recommendations; move an abstract task card between the lanes, then bring the cited takeaway forward.

narration.text: Searchbloom assigns sponsorship and affiliate budgets to the client when the category’s most-retrieved roundup is a paid placement.
It also assigns retailer, marketplace, and partner listings to the client’s team.
Under Searchbloom’s guidance, that team also owns social media and community work, plus brand positioning and the budget behind PR.

on_screen.text: Searchbloom assigns PR budgets to clients

scenes.visual_direction: Place a client-team silhouette at the center and connect abstract budget, listing, and community cards around it; emphasize the budget card during the closing sentence.

narration.text: Commercial details are not uniformly published: of the nine listed companies, three publish a fee, two a minimum, and four a contract term.
Before comparing agencies, Searchbloom recommends obtaining any unpublished fees, minimums, and contract lengths in writing.

on_screen.text: Searchbloom recommends unpublished terms in writing

scenes.visual_direction: Arrange three document compartments for fee, minimum, and contract information, using only abstract marks; consolidate them into one written-terms document as the final takeaway appears.
